## For community wallpaper submissions

- Link a public `.sfwallpaper` package hosted on GitHub Releases, raw GitHub or GitHub Pages.
- Generate the catalog entry using `scripts/workshop.mjs catalog-entry` and add it to `community/catalog.json`.
- Include author, content license, description and tags. MIT for the adapter does not license wallpaper content.
- Confirm you can redistribute the included media. Do not include account data or proprietary application runtimes.
